# ATHENA Glaux Intelligence

> ATHENA Glaux Intelligence is an independent news intelligence service. It collects reports from hundreds of outlets in many countries, groups them into one story per event, and shows how widely, how independently and how seriously each story is reported. Published in English, Greek and French. Updated through the day.

## Sections

- [Front page](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/index.html): The latest assessed stories, newest first.
- [Daily briefing](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/briefing.html): The day's main developments in a short read.
- [Warnings](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/warnings.html): Official travel and safety warnings, gathered in one place.
- [Signals](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/signals.html): Early signals and rising stories across sections.
- [ATHENA Signals](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/athena-signals.html): How signals are shown and what they mean.
- [Analysis Desk](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/analysis-desk.html): Risk readings for security and conflict stories: score, band, confidence and what would change the reading.
- [Analysis Desk method](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/analysis-desk-method.html): What the Desk covers, what it reads, its limits and how to request the full method.
- [Analysis Desk track record](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/analysis-desk-record.html): Every published reading, logged, and how each held up after 14 days.
- [Maritime](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/maritime.html): Shipping, chokepoints and sea routes.
- [Analysis and explainers](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/analysis.html): Background to the stories.
- [Countries](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/countries.html): A page for each country with its stories.
- [Topics](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/topics.html): Running trackers on long stories.
- [About ATHENA](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/about.html): Who runs the site and how.
- [How this is produced](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/how.html): How stories are collected, grouped and assessed.
- [Contact](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/contact.html): Write to the editors.
- [News feed (RSS)](https://athenaglauxintelligence.news/feed.xml): The newest stories as a feed.
